pages.text: Vitrified Waste is nuclear waste made safe: inert green glass. It does $(l)not$() contaminate, so you can store it anywhere or build with it.$(br)$(li)$(l)Get it$(): the $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l) turns every Depleted Fuel Rod into one block.
$(li)$(l)Mine it$() with a pickaxe; it drops itself.$(br)$(li)It glows very faintly.
